_meta.change: split the cogPG.PG139 whole-volume CGPG dump into per-work corpus files
_meta.plan_basis: read at the row. Four blocks: two unidentified head blocks, the Choniates Historia, and a tail index. Only the Historia is carved.
_meta.shared_row_rule: a served row holding a work boundary is assigned to exactly one work, normally the one whose incipit the row carries; the plan records the decision as the ranges themselves
_meta.reversible: To revert: for every carved work file listed under 'works', drop its rows whose locus starts 'PG139.' (delete the file when it was 'created'), strip the 'PG139.' prefix from their loci, re-insert them and the archived 'dropped_duplicates' rows into data/corpus/cogPG.PG139.jsonl together with the residual rows, sorted by locus, and restore data/cgpg_works.json, data/tlg_crosswalk.json/.tsv, and data/corrections_log/provenance.json from the parent commit (or simply git revert the commit; old sha256 below verifies). Every moved row's text is byte-identical; only urn and locus changed.

works.title: Historia
works.secondary_reason: work is served from byzantium.gr's manual transcription, which beats OCR of the same text per the source-precedence tie-break (the precedent is scylitzes-continuatus.continuatio-scylitzae, filed the same way); this Migne witness is kept, not served

incipit_checks.incipit: Αἰ ἱστορίαι δὲ ἄρα κοινωφελίς τι χρῆμα τῷ βίῳ ἐφεύρηται

works.evidence: Locus 167 opens the Historia's proem on the usefulness of history. Locus 527 is simply missing from the file, not a work boundary: 528-536 continues the same post-1204 narrative, Baldwin's death and the Frankish and Venetian occupation, and 536 ends mid-narrative. 154,180 tokens here against 159,273 served, a ratio of 0.97.

residual.note: 13-89 is a set of homilies opening ΛΟΓΟΣ Αʹ and 92-151 a treatise opening ΠΡΟΟΙΜΙΟΝ; the volume's collective label names Isidore of Thessalonica and Joel, but which block is whose is not established here, so neither is carved. 554-558 is a table of contents (Τόμος πρῶτος. Ἐν τῷ πρώτῳ τόμῳ τὸ προοίμιον), not a work.

corrections_mirror_note: data/corrections_log/applied.jsonl keys this volume's corrections by bare column locus under cogPG.PG139; per the rekey_corrections_log.py convention for cogPG.* bare-locus rows they are left unchanged (historical). The locus map above makes the linkage reconstructable.
